description:
Gamble away your ships at the
Interastral Peace Casino

Screenshots:

Spoiler

Safe to add or remove mid-campaign! and should be compatible with all other mods.

How to Play:
Visit any Tri-Tachyon or Player owned market > size 3.

4 minigames to test your luck:

Texas Hold'em Poker -- Classic No-Limit Hold'em against the House AI, including 2-player and 5-player versions.
Blackjack -- 6-decks, not shuffled every hand. (Try counting cards if you're good.)
Tachy-Impact -- A rotating banner gacha system. 160 Stargems per pull and pity system like Genshin/HSR to increase drop chance if you haven't obtained 5-star in 72+ pulls.
Spiral Abyss Arena -- Bet on randomized "Gladiator" ships in a battle royale arena. Has adaptive odds like horse betting: Slow & losing horses/weak & dying ships return more per investment.

Stargem Finances:

Purchase gem packages with credits, or pawn your ships for stargems(at configurable exchange value).
Purchase a VIP Pass (default 100,000 Credits) for 30 days of daily rewards (and daily gacha ads, which you can toggle to monthly in Casino Finances).
Access exclusive VIP benefits such as overdraft credit system and lower interest rate. (Still, you won't want to owe The Casino money)

Cosmicon Collab:
If the Cosmicon Dice mod is also loaded, you can spend stargems at the casino to play dice against a strong opponent and unlock the dice tournament for big rewards!
Note: Cosmicon is not removal safe mid-campaign

Everything is configurable:

Spoiler
Edit data/config/casino_settings.json to customize:
- VIP pass cost and reward, including debt ceiling, interest etc.
- Poker stack sizes and AI behavior
- Gacha rates and pity thresholds
- Arena default setup, gladiator perks and betting odds
- Flavour text such as battle log and VIP ads, and much much more

Changelog:

discordPostHtml:
Gamble away your ships at the IPC!

**Adds a casino where you can lose money via 4 minigames: **

  • Poker (Player vs AI, Texas Holdem, inc. 2-player and 5-player variants)
  • Blackjack (6-decks, allows counting)
  • Ship Gacha (Genshin style, Tachy-Impact™)
  • Arena betting (Spaceship battle royale, has adaptive odds like horse betting)

New - a 5th one will be availible if my other mod, Cosmicon Dice, is also loaded

Along with a debt system (but you don't want to owe the casino money)

  • Plus a battle pass experience complete with daily ads (can be turned off)
  • Plus custom music and a lot of Genshin/Honkai Starrail Memes.

Cosmicon Collab: https://discord.com/channels/187635036525166592/1503113590150795497
If the Cosmicon Dice mod is also loaded, you can spend stargems at the casino to play dice against a strong opponent and unlock the dice tournament for big rewards!
Note: You can remove either mod and keep playing the remaining mod's feature, but may lose saved progress of collab features.

Visit any Tri-Tachyon or player owned colony to play.
Should be compatible with everything and safe to add/remove mid game.
https://s13.gifyu.com/images/bq6mu.gif
https://github.com/zman406986/CasinoMod/blob/master/poker.png?raw=true
https://s13.gifyu.com/images/bmu0W.gif

Almost all values are configurable (just edit data/config/casino_settings.json)
